English: In their own words · from the SSL profile
Everything new in the app – latest first
On Home you can switch between the previous, today’s and the next race day; at midnight Rio time everything moves on by itself.
The app learns from every race how long racing and changeovers take and shows “Probably delayed ~HH:MM” for the following races.
Overall ranking, qualifiers and the Final Series – open places show “(to be determined)”.
The header strip shows the race on the water and the countdown to the next start – and when a start is delayed.
One tap on Android, an arrow that points to the right button on iPhone, and “Open in Chrome/Safari” from WhatsApp & co.
Live positions appear right away, the race history loads in the background.
Under More: tell the app maker what should be better.
SSL Nations Ranking in the app
All 132 nations with continent filter, search, history back to 2025 and each nation's best skippers and crews.
Every sailor's position compared with the team pages and the Rio jersey numbers – several positions are shown where they differ.
No more jumps to other sites
Ranking and qualifier links now open inside the app.
The yellow wedge shows where the wind comes from, the wind speed sits right in the middle.
Team and sailor names now open their page everywhere – tables, results, settings and more.
Polski! The app now speaks 18 languages.
Japan, Czechia, Chile, Ecuador, Hungary, Peru, South Africa and Thailand – fresh from the event studio.
Switch between Matchboard blue, day and night right in the header.
A little more presence at the top.
Competition (rounds + matchboard), Teams and Sailors each have their own tab.
Notifications, start reminders, quiet hours, units, local times and spoiler-free mode in one place.
Teams, sailors and races open as full pages with their own link – back always goes one step back.
Swipe between rounds, with an animation like in the big apps.
An Install button next to the language – the app on your home screen in 20 seconds.
Every boat on the map, live ranking, course and replay – no more external site.
Bio, career, Olympic and world championship medals from the official SSL profiles.
Tap ☆ on a sailor – your sailors get their own list.
Japanese, Thai, Malay, Hungarian, Czech and Ukrainian.
